sources.source_name: TDLR official All Licenses CSV (dbproduction2/ltlicfile.csv)
sources.regulator: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
sources.count_notes: Official daily CSV is 187.40 Mb. This ticket did not ingest the giant file. SODA copy 7358-krk7 has 983,494 rows but is a lagging portal extract (rowsUpdatedAt ~2026-07-16). Prefer dbproduction2 CSVs over SODA. Texas has NO statewide general-contractor license. Trade subsets were counted from official per-type CSVs.
sources.contact_notes: SODA occupancy on the lagging 7358-krk7 extract: business_telephone nonempty 99,720 / 983,494; business_address_line1 nonempty 108,037. No email/website columns. A/C Contractor subset has 0 phones and 0 business addresses in both SODA and the official ltairref.csv.
sources.terms_notes: Public license listing. Verify current status via TDLR License Search. Data last updated on search UI 9/3/2026 06:01.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not commit ltlicfile.csv. Person-named rows are person credentials, not business profiles.
sources.recommended_next_action: Stream official per-trade CSVs (A/C, electrical, elevator, appliance, water well, mold, solar, tow companies). Do not treat 983,494 as a contractor universe.

sources.regulator: Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners
sources.source_clock: agency page: tables updated daily; this file 1,982,197 bytes
sources.count_notes: 9,360 rows; LIC_STATUS Current 8,570 / Expired 790. insurance_fields.note: License existence is not current insurance unless these fields are populated and unexpired. This file proves insurance filing for RMPs.

sources.identity_field: TxDMV certificate / USDOT when the record prints both
sources.count_notes: TxMCCS replaced MCCS/eLINC. Household-goods movers require Form E (liability) and Form H&I (cargo) insurance filings. Truck Stop search publishes filings. Do not scrape.
